card.name: Spots where a time span comes next
card.fires_on: Words right before a time period such as years, months or weeks, often 'Last' at a sentence start or a noun ending a clause. It responds where the next word is likely a span like 'year', 'month' or '20 or 30 years'.

modes.label: Last before a time unit
modes.description: The word 'last' opens a phrase about a recent period such as last year, month or week.
modes.example: experts in Texas grew concerned when

modes.label: Clause end before a duration
modes.description: A noun ends a clause and a time reference or duration is likely to follow.
modes.example: a devastating form of<< cancer>> 20 or 30 years

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with a length of time, such as years, months or a semester, and away from 'during'.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name a stretch of time, like last year or ten years.
